title: fix(rest)!: /meta/_drafts refuses a bracketed packageId or type key instead of listing every draft
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96RirUSzHMtPHuFBWpUKa7o)_
Fixes #29319
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc page teaches a bracketed `packageId` or `type` key on `_drafts` (`git grep` over `skills/`, `content/docs/` and `apps/docs/` finds none); the pages that name `_drafts` teach no query spelling at all.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`GET /meta/_drafts` 收到括号写法的 `packageId`(`?packageId[]=ID`、`?packageId[0]=ID`)或 `type`(`?type[]=TYPE`、`?type[0]=TYPE`)时答 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 并点名该键；以前这些键被忽略，返回全部包、全部类型的草稿。
- **为什么改**:按 qs 风格序列化数组的客户端只想看一个包或一种类型的草稿，却拿回全部草稿并当成过滤结果；这是 #29046、#29298 修过的同一类静默放宽在 `/meta` 上的最后一处。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `packages/rest`(#29298 的括号判定改成按门查表的一个函数，`_drafts` 门入口加同一判定，两条传输共用),`patch` 带 BREAKING 横幅；只影响发括号键的 API 调用方，`@objectstack/client` 与控制台都不发。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`(`META_BRACKETED_FILTERS` 与 `metaBracketedFilterRefusal`);`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` 的 `_drafts` 门入口新增几行;`.changeset/29319-bracketed-drafts-filter-refused.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts`,预期全绿，其中 `a BRACKETED packageId or type key on _drafts` 用例断言 400。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

`?packageId[]=ID`, `?packageId[0]=ID`, `?type[]=TYPE` and `?type[0]=TYPE` reach `GET /meta/_drafts` under the key as spelled: both Hono adapters hand query keys through unparsed (`readQuery` in `plugin-hono-server`, `readDispatchQuery` in `@objectstack/hono`). Both transports read only `query.packageId` and `query.type`, so `listDrafts` was handed no package and no type, and an author who named one package's (or one type's) drafts got every draft with 200.

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`: #29298's `metaBracketedPackageRefusal` becomes `metaBracketedFilterRefusal(door, query)`, driven by one per-door table, `META_BRACKETED_FILTERS`: the list and the book tree judge `package` (as before), `_drafts` judges `packageId` and then `type`. It is the same function, generalised and renamed, not a second copy; it was module-level and never on the package index, so no export moves. The two `package` sentences are byte-identical (#29298's pins pass unchanged). `metaQueryArityRefusal` already asks it after the multiplicity rule, so the runtime dispatcher's `_drafts` gets the refusal with no runtime source change.
  - `packageId`: `Query parameter 'packageId[]' names no package; the 'packageId' filter takes exactly one package id, spelled ?packageId=ID. The list was not served: a bracketed 'packageId' key is not a filter. Name one package, or leave the parameter out to list the drafts of every package.`
  - `type`: `Query parameter 'type[]' names no metadata type; the 'type' filter takes exactly one metadata type, spelled ?type=TYPE. The list was not served: a bracketed 'type' key is not a filter. Name one metadata type, or leave the parameter out to list the drafts of every type.`
- `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`: `RestServer`'s `_drafts` door asks the same decision right after `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`, before `listDrafts`, and writes it in the nested envelope its arity gate writes (as the list door does).
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`: the book tree's call follows the rename (one line).
- The order is unchanged on both transports: capability gate (403), protocol probe (501), multiplicity, then the bracketed key. A bracketed key beside the plain one is refused (two spellings of one filter). `MetaItemQueryRefusal.rule` gains no member: the refusal reuses `bracketed-parameter`, so `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

**Measured on main before any edit (27c1c555).** Real Hono request parsing on both transports (`RestServer` on a `HonoHttpServer`, driven with `app.fetch`; the dispatcher on a raw Hono app with `readDispatchQuery`'s exact query shape), an author caller, four seeded drafts (two packages × two types), brackets sent raw and percent-encoded:

| Request | Both transports on main |
|:--|:--|
| no query | 200, 4 drafts (control) |
| `?packageId=crm` / `?type=view` / both | 200, 2 / 2 / 1 drafts (controls) |
| `?packageId[]=crm`, `?packageId[0]=crm` | 200, 4 drafts, `listDrafts({})` |
| `?type[]=view`, `?type[0]=view` | 200, 4 drafts, `listDrafts({})` |
| `?packageId[]=crm&type[]=view` | 200, 4 drafts |
| `?packageId=crm&packageId[]=hr` | 200, 2 drafts: the bracketed key silently dropped |

**Producer census.** `@objectstack/client`'s `listDrafts` builds both keys with `URLSearchParams.set`; the console builds `?packageId=${encodeURIComponent(…)}` (`usePendingDrafts.ts`, `PackagesPage.tsx`); neither has a qs library; no docs or skill example spells either key bracketed. No real producer sends them.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts` (appended `describe`): the decision as data for `packageId[]`, `packageId[0]`, `packageId[id]`, `type[]`, `type[0]`, `type[name]` (and beside the plain key); a repeated plain `packageId` still answers the multiplicity sentence first; not judged on the list or the tree, nor for `types[]`, `packageIds[]` or `package[]` on `_drafts`; `RestServer`'s `_drafts` answers the nested 400 and `listDrafts` is never called; controls: the plain spellings still narrow, none reads every draft.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/dispatcher-query-arity.test.ts` (appended `describe`): the dispatcher's `_drafts` refuses `packageId[]`, `packageId[0]`, `type[]`, `type[0]` with the same code and sentence before `listDrafts`; beside the plain key too; control: the plain spellings reach `listDrafts`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts` (booted showcase over Hono, appended `describe`): `/meta/_drafts?packageId[]=` / `?packageId[0]=com.example.showcase` and `?type[]=` / `?type[0]=view` answer 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the key, no list, as the admin; controls: `?packageId=` and `?type=` answer 200 with only matching rows, and a member is still refused 403 at the capability gate first.

No existing test was edited; every hunk in a test file is an addition.

<details><summary>Red first on main (a2fcede8, pins at b748eaaf)</summary>

The pins were committed before the fix and run against main's source and dist:

- rest: `Tests 10 failed | 39 passed (49)`: the six as-data cases and the four `RestServer` door cases. Every control and every #29298 pin passed.
- runtime: `Tests 5 failed | 38 passed (43)`: the four dispatcher cases and the beside-the-plain-key case.
- dogfood: the reds are read off the ablation legs below.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: each refused key, and the RestServer hand-off, put back, reds only its own pins</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest build`, then `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs packages/rest MARKER` (marker present in 2 built files) before reading any run. Baseline on the fixed head first: rest `49 passed`, runtime `43 passed`, dogfood file `24 passed`.

1. **packageId.** The `_drafts` table row's `param: 'packageId'` renamed to a marker, so the key is not judged. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `977baa3c` → `69581359`. rest `5 failed | 44 passed (49)` (the three `packageId` as-data cases, the two `RestServer` `packageId` cases); runtime `3 failed | 40 passed (43)` (`packageId[]`, `packageId[0]`, beside-the-plain-key); dogfood `2 failed | 22 passed (24)` (`packageId[]`, `packageId[0]`).
2. **type.** The row's `param: 'type'` renamed to a marker. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `977baa3c` → `36e7b636`. rest `5 failed | 44 passed (49)` (the three `type` as-data cases, the two `RestServer` `type` cases); runtime `2 failed | 41 passed (43)` (`type[]`, `type[0]`); dogfood `2 failed | 22 passed (24)` (`type[]`, `type[0]`).
3. **RestServer hand-off.** The `_drafts` door's call asks an unknown door instead of `'drafts'`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `824a9f54` → `2d929242`. rest `4 failed | 45 passed (49)` (the four `RestServer` door cases); runtime `43 passed (43)` (the dispatcher asks the decision through `metaQueryArityRefusal`, untouched); dogfood `4 failed | 20 passed (24)` (the showcase is served by `RestServer`).

Each restore: blob back to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; then a rebuild, all three markers absent from all 6 built files, whole tree clean (`git status --porcelain` empty).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise.** Holds as the card states it, on both transports, raw and percent-encoded; and beside a plain `?packageId=` the bracketed key was silently dropped.
- **File surface vs the claim.** As claimed, plus the one-line rename at the book tree's call in `meta-item-read-routes.ts`, the other caller of the function this PR generalises. `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` needed no edit: its `_drafts` already asks `metaQueryArityRefusal('drafts', …)`. No `ui/**`, no `packages/spec/**`.
- **Main-red seen on the final head, not this change.** `flow-runas.dogfood.test.ts` (3) and `declarative-endpoint-anonymous-guest.dogfood.test.ts` (1) red with this PR's source set back to main's (see Verification); reported to the seat.
- **Same class, still not fixed here.** `?preview[]=draft` on the list reads as no preview and `?include[]=` as no inclusion (#29298's note). Not measured here; outside this card's keys.
